passage.text: Every employee in Thailand is protected by the law.
passage.reading: ˈɛvri ɪmˈplɔɪiː ɪn ˈtaɪlænd ɪz prəˈtɛktɪd baɪ ðə ˈlɔː.

passage.text: Know your rights, and make sure that your employer respects them.
passage.reading: ˈnoʊ jʊr ˈraɪts, ənd ˈmeɪk ˈʃʊr ðæt jʊr ɪmˈplɔɪər rɪˈspɛkts ðɛm.

passage.text: Your working hours must not be more than eight hours a day or 48 hours a week.
passage.reading: jʊr ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˌaʊərz mʌst ˈnɑːt bi ˈmɔːr ðən ˈeɪt ˈaʊərz ə ˈdeɪ ɔːr ˈfɔːrti ˈeɪt ˈaʊərz ə ˈwiːk.

passage.text: You must have at least one day off every week.
passage.reading: juː mʌst ˈhæv ət ˈliːst ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ ˈɔːf ˈɛvri ˈwiːk.

passage.text: Overtime is not compulsory: your employer must ask you first.
passage.reading: ˈoʊvərtaɪm ɪz ˈnɑːt kəmˈpʌlsəri: jʊr ɪmˈplɔɪər mʌst ˈæsk juː ˈfɜːrst.

passage.text: For overtime on a working day, you must be paid at least one and a half times your usual pay.
passage.reading: fər ˈoʊvərtaɪm ɑːn ə ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˈdeɪ, juː mʌst bi ˈpeɪd ət ˈliːst ˈwʌn ənd ə ˈhæf ˈtaɪmz jʊr ˈjuːʒuəl ˈpeɪ.

passage.text: After one year in the same job, you can take at least six days of paid annual leave.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ˈwʌn ˈjɪr ɪn ðə ˈseɪm ˈdʒɑːb, juː kən ˈteɪk ət ˈliːst ˈsɪks ˈdeɪz əv ˈpeɪd ˈænjuəl ˈliːv.

passage.text: If you are sick, you can take sick leave.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ər ˈsɪk, juː kən ˈteɪk ˈsɪk ˌliːv.

passage.text: You will be paid for up to 30 days of sick leave a year.
passage.reading: juː wɪl bi ˈpeɪd fər ˈʌp tə ˈθɜːrti ˈdeɪz əv ˈsɪk ˌliːv ə ˈjɪr.

passage.text: If you are sick for three days or more, your employer can ask for a medical certificate.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ər ˈsɪk fər ˈθriː ˈdeɪz ɔːr ˈmɔːr, jʊr ɪmˈplɔɪər kən ˈæsk fər ə ˈmɛdɪkəl sərˈtɪfɪkət.

passage.text: Your workplace must be safe and clean.
passage.reading: jʊr ˈwɜːrkpleɪs mʌst bi ˈseɪf ənd ˈkliːn.

passage.text: You must be paid at least the minimum wage.
passage.reading: juː mʌst bi ˈpeɪd ət ˈliːst ðə ˈmɪnɪməm ˈweɪdʒ.

passage.text: Men and women who do the same work must get the same pay.
passage.reading: ˈmɛn ənd ˈwɪmɪn huː ˈduː ðə ˈseɪm ˈwɜːrk mʌst ˈɡɛt ðə ˈseɪm ˈpeɪ.

passage.text: Do you have a problem at work?
passage.reading: duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈprɑːbləm ət ˈwɜːrk?
ˈkɔːl aʊr ˈfriː ˈhɑːtlaɪn, ˈwʌn ˈfaɪv ˈfɔːr ˈsɪks.

passage.text: Don't be afraid to ask for help. It's your right!
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt bi əˈfreɪd tu ˈæsk fər ˈhɛlp. ɪts jʊr ˈraɪt!
